description: This is a Java unit test class for the AuthenticationChain component in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.security.authentication package. It tests various scenarios of authentication provider application and result aggregation.

classes.name: AuthenticationChainTest
classes.description: Unit test for the AuthenticationChain class, verifying authentication logic with multiple providers, result aggregation, and exception handling.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test fixtures such as a known authorization context and message dispatcher executor.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, particularly initializing DittoHeaders with the test method name.

methods.name: getInstanceThrowsIllegalArgumentExceptionWhenProviderListIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that the AuthenticationChain.getInstance() method throws an IllegalArgumentException if provided with an empty list of authentication providers.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Tests the authentication process where a suitable provider authenticates, verifying correct provider invocation and result.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsFirstAuthenticationResultIfMultipleProvidersAreApplicable
methods.description: Verifies that the first applicable provider's result is returned, without invoking subsequent providers.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsIllegalStateAuthenticationResultIfCalledWhenNoProvidersAreApplicable
methods.description: Checks that if no providers are applicable, an IllegalStateException is wrapped in the failed AuthenticationResult.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Validates that when an applicable provider returns failed, the overall result reflects failure.

methods.name: authenticateReturnsSuccessfulAuthenticationResultIfOneProviderSucceeds
methods.description: Ensures that if multiple providers are applicable but one succeeds, the successful result is returned.

methods.name: authenticateAggregatesFailureDescriptionsIfMultipleProvidersFail
methods.description: Tests aggregation of multiple failure results into a single failure with a combined exception message.

methods.name: mockRequestContextForAuthenticate
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked RequestContext with a sample HttpRequest for testing purposes.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Helper method to create a completed CompletableFuture with a given value.
